front_matter.text: Daawita Mazimurii (Mazimuriyaa Mas'aafay) Geeshsha Mas'aafaa giddon Mazimuriyaanne woosa mas'aafaa gidiide erettee. Ha mas'aafaa giigisseeddawanttu adussa wodetuwaa giddon beetteedda dumma dumma asatuwaa. Itti itti mazimuretuwaa Kaatii Daawite s'aafeeddawe ammanettee. Ha mazimuretuwaanne ha woosatuwaa shiishshiide, barenttu goyinuwaa wodiyaan go'ettiiddi gam"eeddawanttu Israa'eeliyaa asatuwaa. Guyyeppe gam"iidde barenttu Geeshsha mas'aafatuwaa giddon gelisseeddino.

Hawanttu ayyaanaappe s'aafetteedda gins's'atuu c'ora k'ommo; unttunttukka galatiyaanne S'oossaw goyinniyaa gins's'atuwaa, S'oossay maaddana mala, naagana malanne saro wotsana mala woossiyaa woosatuwaa, nagaraappe maarettanaw shiishshiyaa woosatuwaa, S'oossaa anjjuwaabaa odiyaa galataa sabatuwaanne morkkatuwaa murana mala S'oossaw odiyaa maganatuwaa. Ha woosatuu itti uray barekka woosseedda woosatuwaanne c'ora Asay ittippe woosseedda woosatuwaa. Unttunttuppe ittuu ittuu itti uraa wozanaan sisetteedda seelaa k'onc'c'issiyaawantta. Haratuu k'ay S'oossaa Asay ubbay koyiyaawaanne asaw ubbaw sisettiyaa hanotatuwaa bessiyaawantta.

Yesuusi tamaarissiidde mazimuriyaa mas'aafaappe bochchi bochchi akkiide tamaarisseedda. Ooratsa C'aak'k'uwaa s'aafeeddawanttukka an s'aafetteeddawaappe barenttu s'aafiyaa mas'aafaa giddo gelisseeddino. Woosa gollatta ek'k'oodeppe doommaade, Mazimuriyaa Mas'aafaa goyinuwaa wogaw go'ettiyaa wolk'k'aama minjjuwaabaadan paydaw.

Med'inaa Goday wolk'k'aama; d'ok'k'a galatay aw bessee.
Asay, «Hoola!» giissiyaa ne oosuwaa wolk'k'aabaa haasayana;

continuations.text: Med'inaa Goday bare geedda k'aalaw ubbaw ammanettiyaawaa;
unttuntta koshshiyaa wodiyaan neeni unttunttoo k'umaa immaasa.

verses.text: Med'inaa Goday bare ogiyaan ubbaan s'illuwaa;

continuations.text: tumuwaan barena s'eesiyaa ubbaw matan de'ee.

verses.text: Med'inaa Goday barena siik'iyaawantta ubbaa naagee;
Taani ta doonaan Med'inaa Godaa galatana.

continuations.text: Med'inaa Godaa bare S'oossaa barew hidootaa ootsiyaa uray,
wolk'k'aama abbaanne Aa giddon de'iyaawaa ubbaa,

verses.text: Med'inaa Godaa galatite! Nu S'oossaa sabbiyaawe lo"a;

continuations.text: unttuntta ubbaakka unttunttu suntsan suntsan s'eesee.

verses.text: Nu Goday wolk'k'aama; Aa wolk'k'ay dara;

continuations.text: ne giddon de'iyaa ne asaakka anjjee.

verses.text: Hinttenoo, ubbaappe bolla d'ok'k'an de'iyaa salotoo,
Unttunttu ubbatuu Med'inaa Godaa suntsaa galatino;

continuations.text: Unttunttu ubbakka is's'anaw danddayenna azazuwaa I unttunttoo immeedda.
Abban de'iyaa med'etatoo, wolk'k'aama abbaa c'iimmatoo,

verses.text: Unttunttu ubbatuu Med'inaa Godaa suntsaa galatino;

continuations.text: Ayaw gooppe, Aa suntsay ubbaappe bollaanna de'iyaawaa;
Aa bonchchuu salotuwaappekka sa'aappekka bollaanna d'ok'k'an de'ee.

verses.text: Aa bagga gidiyaa, aw matattiyaa Israa'eeliyaa asatuu,

continuations.text: Aa galatana mala, I unttuntta minisee.

verses.text: Med'inaa Godaa galatite! Med'inaa Godaw ooratsa yetsaa yes's'ite!

continuations.text: S'iyoone asatuu barenttu kaatiyaan loytsi nashetino.

verses.text: Ayaw gooppe, S'oossay bare asan nashettee;

continuations.text: unttunttu kushiyankka laa"u bagga kuussa mashshay de'o.

verses.text: Aa wolk'k'aama oosatuwaa diraw, Aa galatite;

continuations.text: ubbaappe aad'd'iyaa Aa gitatetsaadan Aa galatite.
Diitsaa diis's'iiddinne lookkuwaa punniidde, Aa galatite.
